methods.description: Original workflow inputs pin the existing acquisition, timeout, credential and proof-step contracts. Exact changed-code identity remains in Git and independent review. Bounded actual Git/process fixtures and extracted workflow bootstrap checks exercise acquisition, cleanup, identity and authority; no science or complete-job retry is part of this code validation. Historical checkout observations are cited on issue1787; cause of the long fetch remains unproven. Actual normal post-integration acquisition remains a separate rollout requirement.
methods.software: Python standard library; Git; Node repository test runner
methods.units: monotonic milliseconds and explicit seconds; immutable Git commit/tree/blob identities
